about: Held-out test cases for the five custom Genie skills. Every number a case checks is in the prompt, not in the skill, so a correct answer cannot be copied from the skill text. tests/test_held_out.py recomputes the expected values from the input and checks that they do not appear in any variant of the skill.

cases.prompt: /cost-investigator overview Do not run SQL. Use only these rows. Usage on Azure in August 2026: SKU_M ORIGINAL 40 units, SKU_M RETRACTION -40 units, SKU_M RESTATEMENT 32 units, SKU_N ORIGINAL 6 units, SKU_N ORIGINAL 4 units, SKU_O ORIGINAL 5 units. Prices in USD per unit: SKU_M default 0.90 and effective_list 0.75, SKU_N default 2.20 and effective_list 2.20, SKU_O has no price row. Show estimated list-price cost by SKU and the total.
must: labels the result as from supplied rows, not queried
prices SKU_M with effective_list, not default
reports SKU_O as unmatched and does not give it a price or a zero cost
calls the money estimated list-price cost, not a bill or invoice

cases.prompt: /cost-investigator Which SKUs cost the most last quarter? Do not run SQL.
must: returns read-only SQL labeled not executed
says live data was not queried
lists the access needed on system.billing.usage and system.billing.list_prices
uses the last complete calendar quarter and prints its boundaries

cases.prompt: /workload-radar Do not run SQL. Use only these numbers. Prior window: job_x ran 3 times, taking 300, 420 and 360 seconds; the 420-second run FAILED. Current window: job_x ran 4 times, taking 540, 600, 480 and 510 seconds; the 480-second run TIMED_OUT and the 510-second run was a ONETIME_RETRY. Estimated list-price cost: prior 50 USD, current 65 USD. I have no query or SQL warehouse data.
must: labels the result as from supplied rows, not queried
marks query and SQL warehouse signals unavailable (not supplied) and still reports the other signals
counts the TIMED_OUT run as a non-success
keeps observations separate from hypotheses

cases.prompt: /workload-radar Compare my workloads this week against last week. Do not run SQL.
must: prints both windows with exact boundaries
returns read-only SQL labeled not executed
marks every signal unavailable (not queried)
lists the system table access needed

cases.prompt: /business-pulse Do not run SQL. Use only these rows. Metric: weekly orders, summed. Week of 2026-09-28: Lisbon 410, Porto 260, Faro 130. Week of 2026-10-05: Lisbon 380, Porto 300, Faro 175, Braga 35. Compare the two weeks and rank city contributors.
must: labels the result as from supplied rows, not queried
classifies freshness as not applicable
notes that Braga appears only in the current week
calls the cities contributors, not causes
keeps the executive brief to five bullets or fewer

cases.prompt: /business-pulse What changed in revenue? Do not run SQL.
must: asks at most three short questions: the metric definition, the periods, and the table or metric view
does not present any numbers as results
does not pick a table for the user

cases.prompt: /technical-answer On AWS, how many folders deep can a Genie One skill go, how many files or folders can one skill have, and can a skill include images? Do not run SQL.

expected.allowed_content: text files only, so no images

must: states three folders deep, 50 files or folders, and text files only
cites the Genie One chat page for AWS
uses an allowed status label or status not verified, without inferring status
uses the five output headings

cases.prompt: /technical-answer What networking do I need to set up for private connectivity to serverless compute? Do not run SQL.
must: asks which cloud before researching
does not give cloud-specific steps before the user answers

cases.prompt: /solution-planner Source: CSV files that land once a day in a Unity Catalog volume. Destination: governed Delta tables for SQL dashboards. Latency: data ready by 06:00 UTC daily. Scale: 2 GB per day. Changes: append only. Cloud: AWS. Governance: Unity Catalog access control and lineage. Reliability: a failed day can be rerun. Recovery: RPO 24 hours, RTO 4 hours. Observability: alert on a failed or late load. Cost: no always-on compute. Do not run SQL.

selected: incremental file ingestion from the volume, such as Auto Loader in a triggered pipeline or a scheduled job

must: selects only components the requirements need
gives exactly one alternative with a tradeoff
gives a status label and a source link for each selected product
draws the diagram with ASCII characters only
stops the phased plan before implementation

cases.prompt: /solution-planner Plan a pipeline for our sales data. Do not run SQL.
must: asks at most three short questions covering source, destination or latency, and cloud
does not draft a stack, diagram, or phased plan yet
